simple.summary: יַעֲרֵי אֹרְגִים (Yaʻărêy ʼÔrᵉgîym) means Jaare-Oregim , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 2Sam 21 19.

definitions.full: H3296. Yaare Oregim אֹרְגִים יַעֲרֵי proper name, masculine father of Elhanan 2Sam 21:19 (= יָעִו֯ר 1Chr 20:5 ); ׳א probably scribal error anticipating ׳א in following line (We Dr), and יַעֲרֵי error for יָעִיר (We) q. v. below עור .
definitions.rootNote: from the plural of 3293 and the masculine plural active participle of 707 ; woods of weavers;
